verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The lemma establishes the finite left-mesh sandwich, the exact infimum representation, upper semicontinuity, and dense-parameter determination, including all extended-real cases. The theorem correctly uses analytic multiplier-ideal subadditivity to obtain the extended-real Fekete limit, checks lower semicontinuity and parameter monotonicity, and constructs bounded continuous finite-ideal approximants decreasing exactly to the raw transform. The corollary correctly applies the theorem to a DXZ perturbation component and uses I-envelope transition invariance to prove component independence. The external references and their ambient hypotheses match every use made in the proof.
